open_text: The confirmation was clear and arrived right away.
I received two different interview times and could not tell which was current.
The portal kept returning me to the login page, but the recruiter helped.
I could not find anyone to contact about changing the time.
Once I found the right person, rescheduling was quick.
The steps were easy to understand.
The status update was useful and concise.
I wanted a clearer explanation of the next step.
The link opened, but the page froze before I could confirm.
Available times disappeared while I was choosing.
No problems and I knew what to expect.
